title: Turning TS2Vec into a Foundation Model for Time Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.28602v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: TS2Vec is one of the strongest self-supervised methods for time series classification, introduced in 2022. It is designed to be trained anew on every dataset: self-supervised pre-training followed by linear probing. Since then, the field has shifted towards foundation models that reuse one encoder across datasets. Yet TS2Vec offers a compact convolutional architecture that operates directly on temporal samples and accepts variable-length inputs without resampling. We ask whether these properties can be retained when the encoder is pre-trained only once, and show that they can: TS2Vec can essentially be turned into a foundation model. Three changes suffice: pre-train on a synthetic corpus, feed the encoder a raw amplitude view and an instance-normalized shape view of the input through two small stems, and distill one specialist encoder per view into a single encoder. translated_title: 将TS2Vec转变为用于时间序列分类的基础模型
translated_abstract: TS2Vec是2022年提出的最强时间序列分类自监督方法之一。它最初的设计是在每个数据集上重新训练：先进行自监督预训练，随后进行线性探测。自那以后，该领域已经转向跨数据集复用单一编码器的基础模型范式。然而，TS2Vec具有紧凑的卷积架构，可以直接处理时间样本，并且无需重采样即可接受可变长度输入。我们探究当编码器仅预训练一次时，这些特性是否能够保留，并证明它们是可以保留的：TS2Vec本质上可以转变为一个基础模型。只需三项改动即可实现：在合成语料库上进行预训练；通过两个小型分支将原始幅值视图和实例归一化的形状视图输入编码器；将每个视图的专门编码器蒸馏为单一编码器。最终得到的TS2Vec-FM是一个160万参数的膨胀卷积网络……
tldr: 仅通过三项改动——在合成语料库上预训练、双视图输入分支以及多编码器知识蒸馏——就将原本需针对每个数据集单独训练的TS2Vec成功转变为可跨数据集复用、仅160万参数的时间序列分类基础模型TS2Vec-FM。
